name: Everyday Cash
summary: See how grocery and dining rewards can work, including eligibility conditions and category caps.
plainEnglish: Cash-back cards return a portion of eligible purchases. The category where you shop can affect how much you earn.
watchOut: Some issuers cap bonus rewards or exclude certain merchants, even when they sell groceries or food.
limitations: Demo terms only: no actual rewards percentage, offer, APR or issuer agreement is represented.
